parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the insulation, compressor, and doors, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and durability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper door of the refrigerator, typically used for the freezer compartment, made of steel with insulation inside.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer section and seals tightly to maintain low temperature.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower door of the refrigerator, used for the main cooling compartment, made of steel with internal insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the main refrigerator section and ensures an airtight seal to maintain cooling efficiency.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open and close.
